message.content: {"caption":"Schematic of the Absolute Zero loop connecting a proposer and solver language model with two environment stages.","description":"A loop diagram has a central Language Model shown as overlapping pink and purple rounded panels, labeled π^propose and π^solve. At left is a green oval labeled “Environment e, f”; at right is another green oval labeled “Environment e.” Four curved arrows connect the model and the environments: the upper-left arrow points from the model toward the left environment and is labeled τ; the lower-left arrow points from the left environment toward the model and is labeled (x, y*), r^propose. The upper-right arrow points from the model toward the right environment and is labeled y; the lower-right arrow points from the right environment toward the model and is labeled r^solve.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
